subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Anaemia in pregnancy: iron, B12, thalassemia and transfusion thresholds

steps.tx: **Anaemia** (**Hb under 11 first and third trimester**, **under 10.5 second** haemodilution; **ferritin under 30** iron deficient, microcytic hypochromic with pencil and target cells; hookworm, malaria, twins, short intervals deplete) with **consequences** (preterm, low birth weight, PPH intolerance, heart failure, impaired lactation) screens every trimester; **deworming** albendazole second trimester and **malaria** prophylaxis pair. Diet alone never corrects moderate.
steps.say: Eleven first ten point five second is anaemia: ferritin 30 replaces. Diet never fixes moderate.

vis.alt: Microscopic view of red blood cells showing small, pale cells, some elongated (pencil) or with central pallor (target), indicative of iron deficiency.
vis.caption: Peripheral blood smear: microcytic hypochromic anemia with pencil and target cells. Image: Ed Uthman from Houston, TX, USA, CC BY 2.0, Wikimedia Commons.

steps.tx: **Oral iron** (**60 mg elemental daily** with vitamin C, empty stomach, **constipation black stools** counselled, tea coffee spaced; **Hb rise 1 to 2 g in 3 to 4 weeks**, continue 3 months postpartum stores) with **IV iron** (**ferric carboxymaltose** late intolerance malabsorption Hb under 7 to 8 near term, hypophosphataemia watched, test dose older) replaces; **anaphylaxis** rare resuscitation ready. Compliance packaging counsels.
steps.say: Sixty milligrams daily black stools spaced tea is oral iron: rises grams weeks. Late intolerant carboxymaltose IV.

steps.tx: **B12 and folate** (**macrocytic** hypersegmented neutrophils, **vegetarian B12** deficient with neuropathy, **folate** 400 mcg preconception 4 mg high risk neural tube, phenytoin lowers) with **thalassemia** (**HbA2** beta trait, **HbH** alpha, partner screening, **iron overload** chelation preconception, **no iron** trait) and **sickle** (crises hydration oxygen exchange, hydroxyurea stopped) splits; electrophoresis types. Folate masks B12 nerves.
steps.say: Big hypersegmented vegetarian is B12 nerves: folate 400 preconception 4 high. Trait screens partner no iron.

steps.tx: **Transfusion** (**Hb under 7** or symptomatic failure, single unit reassess, **crossmatched** warmed, **TACO and TRALI** watched, **Jehovah** cell salvage) with **postpartum** (oral 3 months, IV selected, **delayed cord clamping** 1 to 3 minutes neonatal iron) closes; **malaria** (quinine clindamycin first trimester, ACT later, IPTp SP) and **hookworm** treated root causes. Audit blood rationalises.
steps.say: Seven or failing transfuses single reassessed: cord delayed minutes neonatal iron. Causes treated roots.
